description: Look up the scripting API — what you can call on a type, without reading the type definitions. `ICellRange` lists its members, one line each (signature + summary); `ICellRange.setValues` prints that member's full documentation; any other word searches type and member names; no name lists where to start. Answers come from the same declarations `run` type-checks against, so a member listed here exists.

name.description: A type (`ICellRange`), a member (`ICellRange.setValues`), or a word to search for. Omit for the overview. A leading `SheetXL.` is accepted.

name: api
